# Resultats primaire avec le modèle de base

```{r}

library(readxl)       # lecture des fichiers Excel

library(dplyr)        # manipulation des données
library(tidyr)        # mise en forme des données
```

# Analyse exploratoire

```{r}

head(data_s)
Csdc=data_s$Csdc
count(Csdc) %>%
  mutate(
    pct   = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
    label = paste0(n, "\n(", pct, "%)"),
    Csdc_court = c("Vivant", "Décès cancer", "Décès autre")
  )

summarise(data_s)
plot(data_s$Survivalmonths)
summary(data_s$Survivalmonths)

```

```{r}
# ── Variable numérique : Survivalmonths ──────────────────────────────────────
cat("═══ SURVIE (Survivalmonths) ════════════════\n")
surv <- data_s %>%
  summarise(
    N         = n(),
    Moyenne   = round(mean(Survivalmonths, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Médiane   = median(Survivalmonths, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Écart-type` = round(sd(Survivalmonths, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Variance  = round(var(Survivalmonths, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min       = min(Survivalmonths, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max       = max(Survivalmonths, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1        = quantile(Survivalmonths, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3        = quantile(Survivalmonths, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR       = IQR(Survivalmonths, na.rm = TRUE),
    Asymétrie = round(moments::skewness(Survivalmonths, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Kurtosis  = round(moments::kurtosis(Survivalmonths, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  )

kable(t(surv), col.names = "Valeur",
      caption = "Tableau 2 — Statistiques descriptives : Survivalmonths") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"),
                full_width = FALSE)

# ── Statistiques par groupe (Csdc) ───────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n═══ SURVIE PAR CATÉGORIE DE CSDC ═══\n")
surv_groupe <- data_s %>%
  group_by(Csdc) %>%
  summarise(
    N           = n(),
    `%`         = round(100 * n() / nrow(seer_multi), 1),
    Moyenne     = round(mean(Survivalmonths, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Médiane     = median(Survivalmonths, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Écart-type`= round(sd(Survivalmonths, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Variance    = round(var(Survivalmonths, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Min         = min(Survivalmonths, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max         = max(Survivalmonths, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

kable(surv_groupe,
      caption = "Tableau 3 — Statistiques de survie par catégorie de Csdc",
      row.names = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"),
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(1, background = "#e8f5e9")
```

```{r}

# Chargement des donnees
data_s <- read_excel("C:/Users/VICTUS/Desktop/Régression logistique multinomiale/10.21037atm-2020-57-1 (1vr).xlsx")
df<-data_s 
# Pretraitement
df <- df %>% mutate(across(c(Agegroup, Sex, Race, Primarysite, Grade,
                             Stage, Chemotherapy, Status, Csdc), as.factor))

# Fixation de la categorie de reference pour la variable cible
df$Csdc <- relevel(df$Csdc, ref = "Alive")

# Division train/test 70/30
set.seed(123)
idx <- createDataPartition(df$Csdc, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_data <- df[idx, ]
test_data  <- df[-idx, ]

# Estimation du modele multinomial logit
fit <- multinom(Csdc ~ Agegroup + Sex + Race + Primarysite + Grade + Stage +
                Chemotherapy,
                data = train_data, trace = FALSE)

# Affichage des resultats
summary(fit)

# Predictions et matrice de confusion
pred <- predict(fit, newdata = test_data)
confusionMatrix(pred, test_data$Csdc)

# Probabilites predites (utiles pour calcul d'AUC, etc.)
pred_probs <- predict(fit, newdata = test_data, type = "probs")
head(pred_probs)
```

# Verification des hypothèses

## Multicolinéarité

```{r}
confint(fit, level = 0.95)
vif(fit)
```

```{r}
a=step(fit)
summary(a)
```

```{r}
predict(reg, data.frame(X1 = 1, X2 = 25, X3 = 4), type = "probs")
```

## Significativite du modele wald

```{r}

z = summary(fit)$coeff / summary(fit)$standard.errors
pvaleur = 2 * (1- pnorm(abs(z), 0, 1))
pvaleur
```

## LR

```{r}
fit0 = multinom(data_s$Csdc ~ 1)
rv = fit0$deviance- fit$deviance
ddl = fit$edf- fit0$edf
pvaleur = 1- pchisq(rv, ddl)
pvaleur
```

```{r}
library(stats)
#Pour faire l’approche pas à pas avec AIC :
step(fit, direction = "both", k = 2)
#Pour faire l’approche pas à pas avec BIC :
step(fit, direction = "both", k = log(length(Csdc)))
```

```{r}
pr = predict(fit)
mc = table(train_data$Csdc, pr)
mc


t = (sum(mc)- sum(diag(mc))) / sum(mc)
t

```

```{r}
library(car)
Anova(fit)
```

```{r}
reg <- multinom(Csdc ~ Agegroup + Sex + Primarysite + Grade + Stage +
                Chemotherapy,
                data = train_data, MaxNWts = 15000,  maxit   = 300,  trace = FALSE)

summary(reg)

# Predictions et matrice de confusion

confusionMatrix(pred, test_data$Csdc)

head(pred_probs)
```

```{r}
null_model <- multinom(Csdc ~ 1, data = train_data,
                       MaxNWts = 15000, trace = FALSE)

ll_full1 <- as.numeric(logLik(reg))
ll_null1 <- as.numeric(logLik(null_model))
lrt_chi2 <- 2 * (ll_full - ll_null)
lrt_ddl  <- reg$edf - null_model$edf
lrt_p    <- pchisq(lrt_chi2, df = lrt_ddl, lower.tail = FALSE)

cat("══ TEST DU RAPPORT DE VRAISEMBLANCE (LRT) ══════\n")
cat(sprintf("  Log-vraisemblance modèle complet : %.3f\n", ll_full))
cat(sprintf("  Log-vraisemblance modèle nul     : %.3f\n", ll_null))
cat(sprintf("  LRT χ²(%d) = %.3f\n", lrt_ddl, lrt_chi2))
cat(sprintf("  p-valeur = %.2e\n", lrt_p))
cat(sprintf("  → %s\n",
    ifelse(lrt_p < 0.05,
           "✔ Le modèle est GLOBALEMENT SIGNIFICATIF (p < 0.05)",
           "✘ Le modèle n'est PAS significatif")))
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
```

```{r}
n <- nrow(train_data)
mcfadden   <- round(1 - ll_full1 / ll_null1, 4)
cox_snell  <- round(1 - exp(2 * (ll_null1 - ll_full1) / n), 4)
nagelkerke <- round(cox_snell / (1 - exp(2 * ll_null1 / n)), 4)
deviance_expl <- round(1 - deviance(multimodel) / deviance(null_model), 4)


r2_df <- data.frame(
  Indicateur     = c("McFadden R²", "McFadden R² ajusté",
                     "Cox & Snell R²", "Nagelkerke R²",
                     "Déviance expliquée", "AIC", "BIC"),
  Valeur         = c(mcfadden,
                     round(1-(ll_full1-multimodel$edf)/ll_null1, 4),
                     cox_snell, nagelkerke, deviance_expl,
                     round(AIC(multimodel), 2),
                     round(BIC(multimodel), 2)),
  Interprétation = c(
    ifelse(mcfadden > 0.40, "Excellent",
    ifelse(mcfadden > 0.20, "Bon",
    ifelse(mcfadden > 0.10, "Acceptable", "Faible"))),
    "—", "—",
    ifelse(nagelkerke > 0.60, "Excellent",
    ifelse(nagelkerke > 0.40, "Bon",
    ifelse(nagelkerke > 0.20, "Acceptable", "Faible"))),
    paste0(round(deviance_expl * 100, 1), "% de déviance expliquée"),
    "Plus bas = meilleur", "Plus bas = meilleur"
  )
)

kable(r2_df, caption = "Tableau 8 — Qualité d'ajustement du modèle",
      row.names = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(3, italic = TRUE, color = "gray30")
```
